proposals.before: On dingyou day Hulishi galloped across Han Dewei's path and caused him to fall from his horse; enraged, the Empress Dowager had him executed.
proposals.after: On dingyou day Hulishi galloped across Han Derang's path and caused him to fall from his horse; enraged, the Empress Dowager had him executed.
proposals.reason: Chinese 韓德讓 is Han Derang; Han Dewei is 韓德威, a different person named later in this chapter.

proposals.before: On dingyou day Hulishi charged across and startled Han Dewei's horse so that he fell; the Empress Dowager was angry and killed him.
proposals.after: On dingyou day Hulishi charged across and startled Han Derang's horse so that he fell; the Empress Dowager was angry and killed him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 韓德讓 is Han Derang, not Han Dewei.

proposals.before: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager visited Han Dewei's camp, lavished rewards on him, and had attending ministers divide into teams for backgammon to celebrate.
proposals.after: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager visited Han Derang's camp, lavished rewards on him, and had attending ministers divide into teams for backgammon to celebrate.
proposals.reason: Chinese 韓德讓 is Han Derang; the packet English wrongly uses Han Dewei.

proposals.before: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager visited Han Dewei's tent, richly rewarded him, and ordered attending ministers to divide into teams for backgammon to fully enjoy themselves.
proposals.after: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager visited Han Derang's tent, richly rewarded him, and ordered attending ministers to divide into teams for backgammon to fully enjoy themselves.
proposals.reason: Chinese 韓德讓 is Han Derang, not Han Dewei.

proposals.before: On renshen day marching staff adviser and Xuanyang Hall academician Ma Dechen argued that the surrendered Song troops would never serve reliably and asked that they all be sent home.
proposals.after: On renshen day marching staff adviser and Xuanzheng Hall academician Ma Dechen argued that the surrendered Song troops would never serve reliably and asked that they all be sent home.
proposals.reason: Chinese 宣政殿 is Xuanzheng Hall, not Xuanyang Hall.
